subject.title: [codex] acknowledge terminal Gmail OAuth watch failures

question: Should Gmail watch acknowledge a terminal OAuth failure after persisting recovery state, relying on operator reauthentication plus the next successful watch registration to catch up from the retained cursor?
rationale: This is a deliberate delivery-semantics tradeoff: it stops an unrecoverable retry storm but transfers recovery to a later operator action and registration notification.

options.title: Adopt durable acknowledgement recovery
options.body: Approve the proposed acknowledgement contract after redacted live proof verifies the retained-cursor catch-up for both the intended Gmail and Pub/Sub workflow.

options.title: Retain retry semantics
options.body: Do not acknowledge terminal OAuth failures until a different recovery mechanism can guarantee catch-up without relying on manual reauthentication and watch renewal.

recommendation.title: Adopt durable acknowledgement recovery
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed acknowledgement contract after redacted live proof verifies the retained-cursor catch-up for both the intended Gmail and Pub/Sub workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository and release history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for a user-visible Gmail delivery-policy choice.
